The '''Three Ellas''' was the collective name given to the [[Freeworlds Territory|Freeworlds]] of [[Dorella]], [[Pernella]] and [[Sorella]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. They were situated along the [[Three Ellas Run]]. These three [[Ore/Legends|ore]]-rich [[Star system/Legends|systems]] were heavily settled with [[Mining/Legends|mining]] installations. The Three Ellas were receptive to [[The fringe|fringe]] communities.<ref name="LotE" />
